title: having a bad day
expression: Your dad is having a bad day

sentences.en: All right, what is going on?
What do you think's going on?!
You can't let that bother you.
sentences.ko: 그런 거에 신경 쓰면 안 돼.

sentences.en: It doesn't bother you? You got called to the principal's office.
sentences.ko: 아빠는 신경 안 쓰여요? 교장실에 불려갔잖아요.

sentences.en: I can't be in the same school as him!
Well, I don't see what choice you have.
sentences.ko: 글쎄, 너한테 다른 수가 있는 것 같진 않은데.

sentences.en: Right. Ever since he could talk, I quit having any choices.
sentences.ko: 그렇죠. 걔가 말을 시작한 뒤로 전 선택권이 없었으니까.

sentences.en: I'm telling you, as your coach, quit your whining, get your uniform on and you get your ass back out there.
sentences.ko: 코치로서 말하는데, 징징대지 말고 유니폼 입고 당장 나가.

sentences.en: But what about as my dad?
Your dad is having a bad day. Listen to your coach.
sentences.ko: 네 아빠는 오늘 일진이 안 좋아. 코치 말 들어.
